svg.title: Normalization Sim
svg.desc: Ninety agents' opinions over 150 simulated days, from the simulation itself at its default settings. With a normalizing feed the opinions stay bunched near the middle; with an engagement feed they split into two camps pushed toward the extremes.
svg.text: λ = 0.15 · content pulled toward the mean
λ = 0.15 · own side, a bit more extreme
